text: What does it take to build a bank's e-commerce acquiring system from scratch?
prefix: What does it take to build a bank's e-commerce acquiring system from scratch?

text: This series walks through one, part by part, and this map shows where each part sits.
prefix: This series walks through one, part by part, and this map shows where each part sits.

text: On top are the three users: the merchant's server, the buyer, and the bank admin. Inside is one modular monolith with six modules.
prefix: On top are the three users: the merchant's server, the buyer, and the bank admin. Inside is one modular monolith with six modules.

text: Partner owns the merchants: who they are, their company documents, and whether they may sell.
prefix: Partner owns the merchants: who they are, their company documents, and whether they may sell.

text: Commission decides the fee on every payment.
prefix: Commission decides the fee on every payment.

text: The e POS module knows which e POS terminal, a MID and a TID, each payment goes through.
prefix: The e POS module knows which e POS terminal, a MID and a TID, each payment goes through.

text: The BIN module knows which scheme and which bank issued a card, from its first digits.
prefix: The BIN module knows which scheme and which bank issued a card, from its first digits.

text: The card vault keeps card numbers encrypted, and hands out tokens instead.
prefix: The card vault keeps card numbers encrypted, and hands out tokens instead.

text: Payment creates every payment, debits the card, and resolves the outcome.
prefix: Payment creates every payment, debits the card, and resolves the outcome.

text: Below the app, separate services do one job each: email, a file service for documents, and an adapter for each card scheme, Uzcard and Humo.
prefix: Below the app, separate services do one job each: email, a file service for documents, and an adapter for each card scheme, Uzcard and Humo.

text: The shared infrastructure is Postgres, Redis, Keycloak, Vault, an S3 file store, Temporal, Kafka, and monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana.
prefix: The shared infrastructure is Postgres, Redis, Keycloak, Vault, an S3 file store, Temporal, Kafka, and monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana.

text: Part zero brings up the whole infrastructure with one command: Postgres and Redis, Mailpit, the S3 store, Keycloak, the processing sandbox, Vault, monitoring, Temporal and Kafka, each explained in the episode that first uses it.
prefix: Part zero brings up the whole infrastructure with one command: Postgres and Redis, Mailpit, the S3 store, Keycloak, the processing sandbox, Vault, monitoring, Temporal and Kafka, each explained in the episode that first uses it.

text: Part one covers the merchants: sign-up, email codes, company documents, two-admin approval, and logins and API clients in Keycloak.
prefix: Part one covers the merchants: sign-up, email codes, company documents, two-admin approval, and logins and API clients in Keycloak.

text: Part two holds the money rules: the commission, and the e POS terminals every debit goes through.
prefix: Part two holds the money rules: the commission, and the e POS terminals every debit goes through.

text: Part three handles cards: the Uzcard and Humo adapters as their own services, the BIN module with its bank directory, and a vault that stores only tokens.
prefix: Part three handles cards: the Uzcard and Humo adapters as their own services, the BIN module with its bank directory, and a vault that stores only tokens.

text: Part four is the payment, last, with monitoring, durable retries, and Kafka events, because it needs everything else.
prefix: Part four is the payment, last, with monitoring, durable retries, and Kafka events, because it needs everything else.

text: Part five deploys everything to Kubernetes, then moves the card vault into its own service, to show why clean boundaries matter.
prefix: Part five deploys everything to Kubernetes, then moves the card vault into its own service, to show why clean boundaries matter.
